title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in Igor Funa Ad Inserter…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Igor Funa Ad Inserter plugin, allowing improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This flaw permits code injection via crafted input. The vulnerability affects versions up to and including 2.8.19. It has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.3.
